title: ReturnEngineSchema
description: Schema definition for the investment return engine parameters, strategies, and annualized ROI calculations.

entry_strategy.description: Purchase strategy: SELL_CSP (Sell Cash-Secured Put) or LIMIT_BUY (Direct Limit Buy Order).

exit_strategy.description: Sale strategy: SELL_COVERED_CALLS (Sell Covered Calls for Income Yield) or LIMIT_SELL (Direct Limit Sell Order).

benchmark_entry_price.description: Baseline acquisition price per share in USD.

target_exit_price.description: Target liquidation price per share in USD.

entry_date.description: Planned or executed position entry date (YYYY-MM-DD).

csp_proceeds.description: Total premium proceeds collected from selling cash-secured puts per share in USD.

cc_proceeds.description: Total premium proceeds collected from selling covered calls per share across the holding period in USD.

dividend_proceeds.description: Estimated cumulative dividend proceeds per share across the holding period in USD.

initial_capital_outlay.description: Net cash invested per share after accounting for upfront CSP premiums (benchmark_entry_price - csp_proceeds).

total_proceeds.description: Total terminal cash inflows per share (target_exit_price + cc_proceeds + dividend_proceeds).

net_profit.description: Net dollar gain per share (total_proceeds - initial_capital_outlay).

holding_period_days.description: Duration between entry and exit date in calendar days.

holding_period_years.description: Holding period converted to annual units (days / 365.25).

options_yield_pct.description: Percentage yield generated purely from option premiums ((csp_proceeds + cc_proceeds) / benchmark_entry_price * 100).

total_roi_pct.description: Total unannualized return on invested capital ((net_profit / initial_capital_outlay) * 100).

annualized_roi_pct.description: Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR / Annualized ROI) percentage over the holding horizon: ((1 + total_roi / 100)^(1 / holding_period_years) - 1) * 100.

target_roi_str.description: Human-readable formatted display string (e.g. '21.5% Ann. (107.4% Total)').
